About Goshi Restaurant

A local restaurant in Bank Square Market bringing together the three menus Lahore loves most.

Three kitchens in one place

Whether the table wants desi Pakistani food, Chinese, or quick fast food, Goshi covers all three — so families and groups don't have to split up or compromise on what to eat.

You'll find it on Model Town Circular Road in Block C, inside Bank Square Market — easy to reach from anywhere in Model Town.
